import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_29/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_29/training_1.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Operation 1: JOIN Source5_29_0 and Source5_29_1 on "school_name"
df_joined = pd.merge(df0, df1, on="school_name", how="inner")

# Operation 2: group_by Source5_29_0.school_name, aggregations = avg(Source5_29_0.math_score)
# Since after join, columns from Source5_29_0 are preserved, use 'school_name' and 'math_score' from df0 side
# Group by school_name and calculate average math_score

result = df_joined.groupby("school_name", as_index=False)["math_score"].mean()

# Rename columns to match target schema exactly
result = result.rename(columns={"math_score": "math_score", "school_name": "school_name"})

# Ensure correct dtypes: school_name as string, math_score as float
result["school_name"] = result["school_name"].astype(str)
result["math_score"] = result["math_score"].astype(float)

# Write the result to the target path
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_29/target_multisource.csv"
result.to_csv(target_path, index=False)
